name: Ohira (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ohira village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised mountain with wing-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ohira, a village in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1968.

features.role: Ohira village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised mountain with wing-like strokes
